source.title: extra-eyes IPC concurrency and permissions cargo test pass

acquisition.details: Ran `cargo test` after adding L3 IPC validation fixtures. Result: 15 unit tests passed and 15 integration tests passed. New coverage includes 128KB enqueue/fetch followed by successful daemon ping, 20 concurrent IPC writers enqueuing messages without frame corruption or lost IDs, and owner-only runtime directory/socket permissions.
